summary: Implemented the Tabs feature by reading and editing files only; nothing was run, installed, or committed. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs with state, keyboard handling, digit/number activation, first-character search, range_clicked action, and underline animation watcher); UnderlineBar now yields one rich Text and accepts clickable_ranges before width, attaching range_clicked('<name>') metadata via apply_meta after the drawn runs; Opacity blends only the color and merges it into the existing style so click metadata is preserved; the layout resolver needed no change because its Edge protocol already has size, min_size, and fraction defaults; docs/reference/tabs.md added; tests added in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py, tests/renderables/test_opacity.py, and new tests/widgets/test_tabs.py (plus tests/widgets/__init__.py). Existing tests were not modified. Not verified: no tests were run. Rich is not installed here, so the apply_meta(meta, start, end) signature and Style metadata merging are assumed. The sandbox demo was skipped as optional. Known gap: an empty label gets a one-cell flexible edge because the resolver treats size 0 as flexible.
